conditions: The protected property, all consumed input roles, actual consumer and eligible baseline are identified.
construction: Match the check to the property and its composition/support assumptions; bind assembly and test role-specific mutations at the declared scope.
example: The historical three-bond mutation passed pair checks; its repair still missed a parity-dressed source. The later source repair did not bind the assembled Hamiltonian to the checked bonds.

lesson.applicability: Reviewing finite premise checks, composed workflows, mutation controls and reproducibility claims used by Adversary.
lesson.cause: The checker covered a strict subset of the composed property and input roles; labels such as even, local or repaired hid the missing support and assembly relationships.
lesson.correction: Enumerate the protected property and all consumed roles, bind the candidate to certified components, and justify composition at the claimed scope. Mutate components, auxiliary sources and assembly separately with eligible benign baselines; identify the exact guard or downstream check that detects each case. Before any digest comparison, identify the exact bound object and serialization profile; compare like with like.
lesson.counterexample: R4 pair checks accepted a three-bond trace 1 versus product 1/2; R5 bond checks missed a source trace -1 versus product 0; R6 leaves K assembly unbound. R3 F_R1_DIGEST records a raw-file hash compared with the controller canonical parsed-response digest.
lesson.evidence_excerpt: The frozen sha is the controller's canonical digest of the parsed stage-4 response, not the file bytes; critics are bound to the controller value.
lesson.exceptions: Pairwise checks may suffice under an explicit applicable structural theorem; retain that argument and its hypotheses. Bounded word probes do not prove all words. A checker gap need not refute the actual model or the whole pipeline. Preserve legitimate benign cases and do not assert an old defect still exists.
lesson.failed_claim: Pairwise or component-only checks certify every composed word, auxiliary source and assembled candidate used by the consumer.
lesson.verification: Read all 15 R3-R5 stages 1-5 (158537 bytes) and the earlier reviewed critics/repairs/raw outputs. R5 reports bond and wire repairs; R6 reports source repair but leaves assembled-K binding open. Stage-5 written/presence PASS labels do not verify analytic premises. The prior Fraction check is conditional arithmetic only. No fresh Meron, Lean or provider execution.
